caption: Toggle: flipped on every kick, swapping the matrix between two halves of the palette
why: Some things alternate: left then right, warm then cool, one pattern then the other. Toggle is a switch that flips each time its flip input turns on - wire the beat in and it changes on every kick - or a fixed on or off when nothing is wired.
Its neighbours: Counter counts through more than two; Gate is on and off by a level; Rising edge makes the one-frame tap a flip needs; Toggle is the flip-flop.
steps: **Audio**'s `beat` is **flip**: each kick turns the switch over.
**on** (the setting) is the state it starts in - on.
Its `on` output picks between 0 and 0.5 through a **Select**, added to **Coords** `u` for the **Palette**'s index: each kick the colours jump half the palette, to their opposites.
The trace shows the switch going 1, 0, 1, 0 with the kicks.

try.label: Smaller jump
try.text: the Select's b at 0.15: each flip moves the colours only a little - a shimmer on the beat.

try.label: Start off
try.text: on unticked: the switch starts off - the same flipping, the other way round.
